faces.name: Curse of Inertia
faces.oracleText:
Enchant player
Whenever a player attacks enchanted player with one or more creatures, that attacking player may tap or untap target permanent of their choice.

faces.name: Curse of Leeches
faces.oracleText:
Enchant player
As this permanent transforms into Curse of Leeches, attach it to a player.
At the beginning of enchanted player's upkeep, they lose 1 life and you gain 1 life.
Daybound (If a player casts no spells during their own turn, it becomes night next turn.)

faces.name: Leeching Lurker
faces.oracleText:
Lifelink
Nightbound (If a player casts at least two spells during their own turn, it becomes day next turn.)

faces.name: Curse of Marit Lage
faces.oracleText:
When this enchantment enters, tap all Islands.
Islands don't untap during their controllers' untap steps.

faces.name: Curse of Misfortunes
faces.oracleText:
Enchant player
At the beginning of your upkeep, you may search your library for a Curse card that doesn't have the same name as a Curse attached to enchanted player, put it onto the battlefield attached to that player, then shuffle.

faces.name: Curse of Oblivion
faces.oracleText:
Enchant player
At the beginning of enchanted player's upkeep, that player exiles two cards from their graveyard.

faces.name: Curse of Obsession
faces.oracleText:
Enchant player
At the beginning of enchanted player's draw step, that player draws two additional cards.
At the beginning of enchanted player's end step, that player discards their hand.

faces.name: Curse of Opulence
faces.oracleText:
Enchant player
Whenever enchanted player is attacked, create a Gold token. Each opponent attacking that player does the same. (A Gold token is an artifact with "Sacrifice this token: Add one mana of any color.")

faces.name: Curse of Predation
faces.oracleText:
Enchant player
Whenever a creature attacks enchanted player, put a +1/+1 counter on it.
